julesThoughtProcess: Chose a vibrant neon teal to reflect grounded optimism and a slice-of-life technological resilience.
storyPanel: The hum of the neighborhood's communal atmospheric scrubber was a familiar comfort. Below its turning blades, an elderly human and a weathered maintenance bot shared a thermos of synthesized tea. They watched the neon lights flicker to life as evening descended. It wasn't a perfect world—the filters still needed constant repair and the air tasted faintly of ozone—but in these shared moments of quiet connection, the city felt like home.
